issues.claim: HybridCache L1 hands out the same instance without deserialization only for types marked as immutable (`sealed` with `[ImmutableObject(true)]`)
issues.problem: The cited excerpt does not show this claim. From my own knowledge it is essentially right: mutable types are deserialized on each read. 'Only for' slightly overstates, because other immutable shapes (for example string and readonly structs) are also reused without copying.
issues.suggestedFix: Soften to: 'in particular for types marked immutable (a `sealed` class with `[ImmutableObject(true)]`); otherwise each read deserializes a fresh copy, so prefer immutable cached types for hot keys'.
